title: Autonomous forward observation of the frozen WP-EDGE-03 lane
does_not_authorise: PAPER or LIVE trading: reaching the observation floor makes a later decision possible, it does not make it, and this lane cannot promote a strategy

lane_commits.subject: Say a pid cannot be probed instead of crashing the lease. [WP-EDGE-04]
lane_commits.why: a shared-module fix, committed on its own because every campaign that takes this lease had the same trap

lane_commits.subject: Make the forward lane tick itself, once per slot. [WP-EDGE-04]
lane_commits.why: the lane itself: the tick engine, its single portable entry point, its verifier, its closure and the versioning exception that publishes them

probe.command: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/true timeout 60 git push --dry-run origin HEAD
probe.reading: the push never completes and prints nothing: the credential helper is waiting for a prompt that is disabled. A dry run, so nothing left this machine

push.action_taken: the commits stay local rather than being re-attributed to someone else; the probe was a dry run and no credential was supplied
push.note: this is the same blocker the earlier work packages recorded, re-probed after this work package's commits rather than assumed

closing_health_reasons: the measured growth rate is volatile

data.point_in_time: only bars that had closed at the tick's own market instant are requested; a bar still open is not fetched, not counted and not called a gap
data.latency_rule: close to store, measured per bar this tick pulled; a bar counts forward only if it arrived within 30 min (15m) or 2 h (1h) of closing

ruleset.checked_on_every_tick: forward_plan.assert_frozen_params() runs first; a moved ruleset is VERIFICATION_FAILED (exit 6), never a warning

strategies_evaluated.reading: each arm is re-read over the whole forward window on every tick; the figures are hypothetical, and no arm is ranked, chosen or promoted here

decisions.reading: a decision is a hypothetical signal under the frozen ruleset; a refusal is a decision the ruleset declined to take. Both are evidence; neither is an order

hypothetical_economics.reading: hypothetical only: these are the frozen ruleset's numbers over the forward window with costs and slippage applied, not a realised result and not an expectation of one

risk_engine_parity.reading: the research budget is compared with the real Risk Engine's own decisions on the same inputs; a difference is named, never smoothed

errors.reason: holder pid 35104 is live and renewed
holder pid 1308 is live and renewed

pre_fix_rows_that_survive.note: announced a recovery with nothing to recover from: a healthy tick after a healthy tick. Written before the vocabulary was fixed; left in place rather than hidden
the same, on the second tick

alerts.post_fix_behaviour_observed: the only later HEALTH_RECOVERED (12:25:55Z) follows the HEALTH_DEGRADED episode recorded at 11:55:56Z
alerts.removed_row: one further pre-fix row, announcing a recovery while carrying state DEGRADED, was dropped from the bounded alert log while the vocabulary was fixed; its text lived only there and is not quoted. The run log was not rewritten
alerts.no_order_or_promotion_alert: no alert in the vocabulary can place an order or promote anything

publication.cadence: once per 24 h, not per tick; every later tick records 'the publication cadence has not elapsed'

offline_reproduction.cumulative_difference: one line: 'Ledger rows on file: 228' now against '12' as published. write_observability() counts the ingest ledger's rows on disk at the path the payload names, so that line is a live reading rather than a function of the preserved payload. Three of four reproduce byte for byte; the property holds but it expires, and it is reported rather than claimed away

failed_then_fixed: DAILY_EVIDENCE_CONSISTENT: a day file that let a repeat trigger overwrite an interval's numbers
BUDGET_DECLARED_MEASURED_AND_BOUNDED: a reading taken before the tick's own row was on disk
BUDGET_DECLARED_MEASURED_AND_BOUNDED: a snapshot that copied a curated list instead of the whole state root
independent_verification.self_test_blind_spot_found: the 'grow a bounded log past its cap' sabotage was caught only as a side effect of a byte comparison; the cap arm itself compared names the bundle never loads. Both were repaired

rerun_on_the_committed_snapshot.reading: the committed snapshot re-derives the published verdict rather than merely being described by it

resources.forecast_rule: a forecast is published only when the measured rate is stable; an invented number is worse than no number

forward_coverage.rule: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the bars the calendar expects and those bars reached the store while still fresh
forward_coverage.reading: zero, and zero is correct: the frozen corpora cover history, and a day on which the scheduler ran is not a forward day. This is an observation requirement, not an admission

not_exercised: a long unattended window: 2 h 5 m of scheduled firing was observed, which is not 60 days of it
logoff or reboot across a tick: the task runs under InteractiveToken and surviving logoff needs stored credentials this work package is not authorised to hold
Linux registration: no POSIX host here; the runner is portable and the cron/systemd lines are declared
a real provider outage: the venue answered all day
live DISK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / VERIFICATION_FAILED / RUNTIME_EXCEPTION / STALE_DATA / MISSING_BARS: exercised in the suite and the sabotage matrix, not live
